title:
乐乐老师，
把眉形放回五官里看。
title_en:
Lele.
Brows considered with the whole face.
intro: 自然柔和、原生态，是乐乐偏爱的审美方向；它不是限制顾客的固定答案。每一次设计，都从具体的人和具体的喜好开始。
intro_en: A soft, natural appearance is Lele’s personal preference, not a fixed answer for every client. Each design begins with the individual and their preferences.
home_intro: 个人审美偏自然柔和、原生态，但不把自己的偏好当作顾客唯一的选择。先了解你，再把眉形放回你的五官里。
home_intro_en: Lele personally favours a soft, natural appearance, but her own preference is not the only option for a client. She starts by understanding you and considering the brows as part of your whole face.
home_history: 2016年进入纹绣行业，经历连锁机构工作与培训讲师工作；2024年8月在上海浦东三林创立描眉画目。
home_history_en: She entered the field in 2016, worked in beauty and specialist brow chains, and gained training and teaching experience. She opened Miaomeihuamu in Sanlin, Pudong, in August 2024.
history: 2016年进入纹绣行业，曾在大型连锁美容院担任外聘纹绣师，在专业纹绣连锁机构从事纹绣工作，也有培训和纹绣讲师经历。
history_en: Lele entered the field in 2016, worked as an external practitioner for a large beauty chain and within a specialist brow chain, and gained training and teaching experience.
current: 2024年8月，在上海浦东三林创立描眉画目·定制美学。如今由本人一对一设计操作，同一时段只接待一位顾客。
current_en: In August 2024 she opened Miaomeihuamu in Sanlin, Pudong. She now personally handles design and treatment, seeing one client at a time.
